text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
choice_data_list: You're quite calm, aren't you, Fenomeno.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes, to be honest, losing a race that I 
went into fully prepared was quite 
tough...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
However, when I think of the days spent 
training alongside the Boss after that, I 
have no worries at all.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I can say with my head held high that who 
I am right now is worthy of being a role 
model!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I shall be off, sir! Please 
watch over me until the very end.
